slides.headline: The 2026 Debt Wall is here.
slides.body: Your 3-year floating rate debt has matured. Cap rates have expanded. Your building is worth less on paper than when you bought it.

slides.headline: The bank doesn't care about your dog park.
slides.body: They only care about your Net Operating Income (NOI). If it isn't higher than it was 3 years ago, prepare for a massive cash-in refinance.

slides.headline: You can't just raise rent anymore.

slides.headline: But you can't cut what you can't see.
slides.body: If approvals are stuck in emails and vendors are overcharging you, you are flying blind into a hurricane.
